goodnews.h: LA's fall showstopper: the Chinese flame tree
goodnews.b: Chinese flame trees are brightening Los Angeles with yellow fall blooms that give way to pink or reddish capsules reminiscent of paper lanterns.
goodnews.title: Move over, jacaranda. LA’s fall showstopper is the Chinese flame tree

local.b: After two deadly Legionnaires' outbreaks this summer on the Upper East Side and in the Bronx, a City Council bill would require building owners to report lower levels of Legionella in cooling towers.
local.title: NYC Council to consider earlier Legionella reporting after deadly outbreaks

local.b: A four-alarm fire scorched a commercial building on Hylan Boulevard, injuring two people including a firefighter, but the nearby Old Church of St. Joachim and St. Anne was not damaged, the FDNY said.
local.title: Staten Island fire injures 2, but spares historic 'Godfather' church

local.h: Bail reform still central in NY governor's race
local.b: Seven years after it became law, bail reform remains a major issue in the governor's race, with opponents pointing to cases like a Rochester man who fired at an officer while out on bail.
local.title: Bail reform remains major issue in NY governor's race, 7 years after it became law

local.b: In a TV address, Macron said nothing 'explains, excuses or justifies' the violence and looting, but promised meetings to address the cost-of-living worries of those who protested peacefully.
local.title: LATEST: Macron says 'nothing justifies' scenes of violence in France

local.b: Saturday's protests brought clashes, street blazes and widespread looting, with masked crowds stripping stores. Prosecutors said more than 500 people were held in custody.
local.title: IN PICTURES: 'Like we had a war': France counts cost of violent protests

local.h: Limoges town hall 'largely lost' to protest fire
local.b: Masked protesters set fire to the 143-year-old building, whose roof collapsed onto lower floors, the regional prefect said, calling it 'a catastrophe for heritage.' The fire is now contained.
local.title: Town hall in Limoges 'largely lost' to blaze set during French protests

local.h: A year after heist, Louvre faces uncertain future
local.b: The Louvre is closing security gaps exposed by last year's theft of eight crown jewels, but its reputation has suffered and its aging infrastructure is a growing concern.
local.title: After a year in turmoil, the Paris Louvre faces uncertain future
